title: Pinned module releases
description: An empty list installs nothing. Each entry identifies one exact release asset.

module.description: The module suffix used after ambitious-, such as tasks.

version.description: An exact semantic version, without a range or tag prefix.

url.description: The HTTPS release asset URL, without credentials, a query or a fragment.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 digest of the release asset in lowercase hexadecimal.

runtimeSha256.description: Optional, for a .pyz module that releases a pinned runtime: the SHA-256 of its runtime lock, the release asset whose name ends in .runtime.txt, in lowercase hexadecimal. The runtime is built only when asked for.
